---
title: Cross-references between notes
author: Test Author
---

The first claim rests on a source.[^1] The second claim extends it.[^2] The
third returns to both.[^3] The fourth cites a note that does not exist.[^4]

[^1]: Moses Maimonides, *Treatise on Logic* (Press, 1938), 5.

[^2]: Maimonides, *Treatise on Logic*, 9.

[^3]: See note 1 above on the *Treatise on Logic*, and notes 1 and 2 above.

[^4]: Compare supra note 3, and note 9 above. In the source, note 4 records a variant reading.
